defensiveAbilities.name: Breath of the Bog
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new saving throw at the end of its turn.

A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to breath of the bog for 24 hours.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rise Up
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks on top of a bog mummy that lies buried in the mud or peat below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

Effect The bog mummy automatically notices the creature and Burrows before rolling initiative.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bog Rot
offensiveAbilities.description:
This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with Cleanse Affliction or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease. A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank Resurrect ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 3d6 Void Damage damage and Clumsy 1 (1 day)
